verdict.rationale: Pinecone has a documented API reference section (docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/introduction) and a machine-readable llms.txt, so a reference exists for users and agents to explore. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or has runnable examples, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec at the common paths. missing for 10: evidence of interactive try-it/runnable request examples in the API reference, a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
